name: Should I create an open-concept opening or keep standard doorways into the addition?

mainEntity.name: Should I create an open-concept opening or keep standard doorways into the addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modifying interior spaces for an addition often means choosing between an open-concept layout or maintaining traditional room separation. Creating a wide, open walkway improves traffic flow and brings natural light deeper into older parts of the home. However, it requires larger structural support beams, temporary shoring, and potential ductwork relocation. Preserving a standard cased doorway reduces structural restructuring and lower drywall patching needs, but it can leave the new addition feeling somewhat detached.
acceptedAnswer.description: Open openings improve light and traffic flow but require larger beams; standard doorways cost less structurally but may feel less integrated.
